detail.note: an answered question here is a confident fabrication about an event that never happened

detail.comparability_note: graded deterministically; LongMemEval's published protocol uses an LLM judge, so this figure is a regression signal and not a comparable score

temporally_clean_subset.note: diagnostic, not the headline. Excluded cases hold memories dated after their own question, so a clock-honouring system is penalised relative to one that ignores the clock. A large gap between this and the headline is a signal about clock handling

corpus_variant.note: LongMemEval-S variants differ by roughly 0.5-2 pp; a published number that does not state its variant is not comparable to this one

evidence_precision.note: precision against benchmark gold evidence. NOT the K1 headline, which is human-judged injection precision.
